name: GKE Admission and RBAC Persistence
description: On GKE, the same Kubernetes objects that persist on AKS persist here: admission webhooks, CronJobs, RoleBindings, ClusterRoleBindings. They keep the attacker in the cluster after the GCP login is revoked. GitOps should be the only writer of those objects. Bindings to cluster-admin and new mutating webhooks are the ones that matter first.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
